Package dev.turboism.sdk.config

Class ConfigCodecs

java.lang.Object
dev.turboism.sdk.config.ConfigCodecs
public final class ConfigCodecs extends Object
Factory methods for the closed set of typed configuration codecs recognized by the runtime.

The returned type identifiers are part of the persisted configuration contract. Do not construct equivalent identifiers manually or rely on an unrecognized custom codec.

      public static ConfigCodec<List<String>> boundedStringList(int maximumEntries, int maximumEntryLength)
      Returns the codec for a list of bounded strings.
